topic: protect a camera from rain or moisture
core_question: How do I protect my camera from rain while shooting outdoors? (secondary: How do you get a smooth, streak-free finish when painting a wall instead of visible roller texture?)
answer_summary: Shield the camera with a dedicated rain cover or an improvised plastic bag with a hole for the lens, and afterward store the gear with silica gel packets to absorb any residual moisture.; after the topic shift: Choose a roller nap suited to the wall texture and paint type, load it evenly, and finish each section with light, even back-rolling strokes in one direction.
